Done. Mesa Vista 4C did **not** reconcile clean, so I corrected it in place rather than closing it as-is. Here's where it landed.

## What I found
I pulled every 4C payout from QuickBooks and set it against Linda's invoice (2026-534). Two of the four charges on that unit were **our own time**, not outside-vendor work:

| 4C item | We actually paid | On Linda's bill | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| Deep clean — Sunshine Cleaning | $387 | $387 | ✅ clean, to the dollar |
| Interior repaint — Pete Donovan (AP PD-2026-09) | **$1,340** | $1,140 | ❌ understated $200 |
| Closet-trim touch-up (AP 2026-519) | $85 *(internal)* | $95 | ❌ shouldn't be billed at all |
| Condition-inspection walk (Alamo HVAC 2026-481-566) | $85 *(internal)* | — | ✅ correctly off |

The closet-trim invoice 2026-519 is billed **to "Tony Reyes, Maintenance Technician, Star Property Management"** — it's entirely in-house staff time (Jaime Salinas' QC walk, your routing, Tony's touch-up, the Airtable update). Per your rule that only outside-vendor work passes through, that whole line comes off her bill — same category as your own make-ready walk.

**Correct owner cost = $387 + $1,340 = $1,727.00** (her invoice said $1,622 — the $200 undercharge and the $95 that shouldn't have been there netted to a real gap).

## What I did (no second bill — corrected the one she holds)
1. **QB invoice 2026-534 corrected in place** → repaint fixed to $1,340, closet-trim line removed, total now **$1,727.00**. Customer memo rewritten to supersede the old summary; private note documents the reconciliation.
2. **Airtable 4C make-ready record** → set to **Ready/closed** with the final owner cost ($1,727) and the internal-vs-vendor breakdown recorded.
3. **Email to Linda** — drafted (short note explaining the $1,622 → $1,727 change and that the updated invoice replaces her earlier summary). One flag: the Gmail toolset here only supports drafting, not sending, so it's composed and queued in your drafts ready to go out — it will need a send from your side.
4. **Slack #make-ready** — posted the corrected $1,727 figure for the crew and front office so anyone touching Linda's account works off the right number.

One note for your awareness: there are **two** 4C rows in Airtable — I closed the "In Progress" one you'd left open; a duplicate already sitting at "Ready" (move-out 6/1) is still there if you want to clean it up later. And the QB private notes on the AP bills reference a "Pete Donovan owner account" for pass-through — that's a mislabel; I billed against Linda per your instruction, but worth correcting in the bookkeeping when you get a chance.
